scene.importHint: Replaces the object of the scene. It is copied into the project when you save.

references.help: Images that guide the generation. One image is enough; several views of the same object improve the result.
references.dropHint: PNG, JPG, WebP · up to 20 MB

viewport.error: The model could not be loaded: {{message}}
viewport.hint: Drag to orbit · Wheel to zoom · Right button to pan

session.label: Session
session.title: A new session, every possibility
session.description: The references of your work will gather here.

jobs.title: No jobs yet
jobs.description: Generations and operations run here one at a time.

process.label: Process
process.title: No trace yet
process.description: Inputs, intermediate steps and parameters of each job.

timeline.label: Timeline
timeline.title: No animation
timeline.description: Keys and tracks of the active clip.

inspector.title: Configuration

engine.title: Generation engine
engine.help: Local model that turns references into a 3D object.

quality.title: Quality
quality.help: Fast, balanced and high use 15, 30 and 50 steps.

scale.title: Physical scale
scale.help: Scales the result uniformly to a real height in meters.

retopology.title: Automatic retopology
retopology.help: Rebuilds a clean mesh with new UVs and transfers the color.

optimize.title: Optimize and LOD
optimize.help: Reduces triangles to a budget and creates up to three levels of detail.

inspect.title: Inspect mesh
inspect.help: Finds open borders, non-manifold edges and disconnected parts.

texture.title: AI texture
texture.help: Generates color and PBR maps for the model.

materials.title: Materials
materials.help: Edits base color, roughness, metalness, normal and AO maps.

paint.title: Paint 3D
paint.help: Paints, clones and restores color directly on the surface.

uv.title: UV
uv.help: Unwraps and packs UVs and exports a template.

normals.title: Normals
normals.help: Recalculates normals and bakes them from a detailed source.

proportions.title: Adjust proportions
proportions.help: Compares the silhouette with the references and corrects it.

projection.title: Reference projection
projection.help: Projects references with explicit cameras to fix details.

rig.title: Skeleton
rig.help: Creates and edits a humanoid skeleton with weights.

clips.title: Clips
clips.help: Library of animations to play, edit and export.

video.title: Motion from video
video.help: Captures body movement from a local video.

glb.title: Export GLB
glb.help: Writes the active version as a self-contained GLB.

lod.title: Levels of detail
lod.help: Exports each LOD as a separate file.

inspector.generateReady: The job runs locally and appears in the job queue.
inspector.generateQueued: A job of this engine is already in the queue.

engine.noneHint: Engines are installed from the model manager.

hardware.title: Hardware and engines
hardware.enginesHint: Engines are read from the engines folder inside the data folder. Each one runs in its own process, without network access.

project.name: Project name
project.saveDescription: Give the project a name. It will be stored on this computer.
project.guardDescription: The current project has unsaved changes. Save them before continuing?
